Nordic Anchor &amp; Steel Pile Supply AB: Nordic Anchor & Steel Pile Supply AB (NASPS AB) is proud to contribute to the development of Röda Ulven, which continues to grow its production in Skagshamn through a planned expansion of the existing facility.
Projektet omfattar ett nytt kyllager om: The project comprises a new cold storage facility of approximately 500 m², intended to strengthen the company's capacity to handle variations in raw material supply and to ensure a stable supply of surströmming to the market. The investment is an important step in future-proofing production within an industry that in recent years has been marked by limited availability of herring.
Utbyggnaden sker i direkt anslutning til: The expansion takes place directly adjacent to the existing factory in Skagshamn and is a strategic investment to optimize storage, logistics and quality throughout the entire production chain.
I projektets grundläggningsfas har NASPS: In the project's foundation phase, NASPS AB has supplied 75 R51/29 anchors, contributing to a safe and efficient foundation for the new facility.
Leveransen genomfördes i samverkan med N: The delivery was carried out in collaboration with Nordisk Grundteknik AB as drilling contractor. NASPS AB thanks them for the order and looks forward to further collaborations.
